scope: Read existing small raw JSON and validation, arithmetic/case-count reconciliation, and validator source; no rerun, profile, large hash or performance credit
limitations: This is a 30-second zero-refusal cost cell at 500 offered operations/s, not a capacity estimate, parity result or 30-minute acceptance cell.
Process CPU and allocated-byte totals include producer/harness, driver/framework, DTO/string/JSON; framework-only 0 B remains unproven.

GC counts and pause use process scope. Peak RSS is lifetime-to-snapshot; released RSS follows tracked-owner release and about 5 seconds idle without forced GC, not proof of all-native allocation release.
Latency values are histogram-bin upper bounds, with separate service, scheduled-to-completion and start-delay histograms.

PostgreSQL must report visible-proc inner/outer observation intervals separately from wait4 process-tree lifetime; no addition and no claim of exact steady bounds. Exited-unobserved children/non-atomic transfer loss remain unknown.
freeze is null for this screening lane; final long cells require their separately frozen conditions and validation.
